vram.title: S-OS Memory & AI Infrastructure™
vram.subtitle: From $1.50 microcontrollers to $30,000 GPU AI servers. Eliminating memory limits and accelerating AI model execution across all hardware tiers.
vram.productEdgeDesc: For ESP32, STM32, RP2040, PIC32, robotics, and IoT devices. Extends SRAM up to 43x using in-flight LittleFS/FRAM compression.
vram.productGpuDesc: For PCs, AI workstations, and LLM servers. Enables running 70B+ LLM models on standard consumer GPUs with compressed PCIe Tensor Offloading and CUDA Cosine Resonance.
vram.esp32Desc: Full C++11/14 support for ESP32, STM32, RP2040, and PIC32. Tested on 8.0MB+ V-RAM with 0 errors and 43.54x compression.
vram.gpuDesc: Native CUDA C++ integration for NVIDIA RTX 3090/4090/H100. Accelerated vector search and Tensor Paging.
vram.matrixSubtitle: Select the optimal vram(blockSize, ramLimit, maxBlocks) parameters for your embedded application:
vram.modeDensityUse: Dataloggers, smart meters, dense databases, telemetry.
vram.modeCriticalUse: Time-critical robotics (LIDAR, autonomous navigation), real-time AI, framebuffers.
vram.modeMassiveUse: Chips with 16MB+ Flash (N16), large AI neural lattices, image caching.
vram.modeMicroUse: Sub-$1 MCUs, minimal heap environments, basic event counters.
vram.communityDesc: Max 512 KB V-RAM. Permanently free for prototypes, evaluation, and non-commercial open-source projects.
vram.proDesc: Unlocked V-RAM (up to 16MB+). Perpetual license for 1 product + 12 months of free updates and email support.
vram.growthDesc: Unlocked V-RAM (up to 16MB+). Perpetual license for fast-growing series + 12 months of support.
vram.enterpriseDesc: Royalty per unit (or $15,000/year). For V-RAM GPU/AI workstations. Includes Source Code Escrow and SLA support.
vram.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About V-RAM Engine
vram.faq1Q: Is the license a one-time payment or does it renew every year?
vram.faq1A: The Commercial Pro ($299) and Growth ($1,499) licenses are perpetual. They are paid as a one-time fee and grant you lifetime manufacturing rights for your device. The software in your devices never expires.
vram.faq2Q: What compression ratio can I expect on my real-world data?
vram.faq2A: The 43.54x ratio is a V-RAM Peak achieved during boundary stress testing on synthetic repeating patterns. For real-world CAN-bus vehicle telemetry, sensor logs, and neural network weights (AI weights), typical real-world compression ranges from 3x to 8x, which still reduces Flash storage usage and wear by over 75%.
vram.faq3Q: What happens if I manufacture more devices than the license threshold allows?
vram.faq3A: Production thresholds (Volume Caps) protect smaller startups and inventors. If your production exceeds 2,000 units per year, you simply pay the difference to upgrade to Commercial Growth or switch to the Enterprise OEM Royalty model ($0.15 per unit).
vram.faq4Q: How is V-RAM AI/GPU™ licensed for PCs and servers?
vram.faq4A: V-RAM AI/GPU™ for CUDA and PyTorch is licensed per GPU workstation ($999/GPU) or through an Enterprise Server package with unlimited nodes.
